name: PIG
source:
In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last. 

Though the game is simple... what The Alleyman offers isn’t: more time. Beat him, and attain extra life—lose, and he takes what time you have left. 

And you? You’re dying anyway, frail body ravaged by an incurable disease. 

A single die. A single choice: Will you take the deal? 

[From [url=https://deadline-co.itch.io/pig]itch.io[/url]]
